'''Jeff Baxter''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 4th at [[February 2002 Parker tournament]] on 2 February 2002 with DS Walker Garrison and [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed|LS Rebel Strike Team]], according to Tom Meade's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3338">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-06-the-downfall-of-swccg-parker-cod3338/ the-downfall-of-swccg-parker-co], DeckTech (Tom "Divebum101" Meade, 6 February 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-06-the-downfall-of-swccg-parker-cod3338/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
